localizedFasteners.scope: Only triangles wholly inside the 48 existing head envelopes may change; exact seven-decimal position triangles outside remain frozen. Actual central ray verifies a positive-depth closed recess.

fluidJunctionAudit.method: Actual unchanged route lengths and UV offsets; modulo phase checked at all six supply/inlet/channel/outlet/return joins and both trunks, with positive interior derivative and exact endpoint speed match.

manifoldSealAudit.method: 108 rays through actual opposite (+Z/front) walls at the 12 branch axes plus 18 rays through the two unused header ends; requires distinct inner/outer metal surfaces and positive wall thickness.

fluidWallAudit.scope: Actual fluid stream surfaces vs every companion solid surface, including annular hose/port bores, headers, copper floors/walls/dividers and nickel covers.

plumbingMotionAudit.method: 20 actual triangle samples of full plumbing transform against immutable bare hardware and same-time plate/frame/mount transforms; no AABB-only clearance claim.
